entries.00c3a807a2fc471b: There are three reportable segments: the Vegetable Seedling and Seedling-Related Business, the Agricultural and Horticultural Seed and Material Sales Business, and the Retail Business. For the fiscal year ended October 2025, the Vegetable Seedling and Seedling-Related Business accounted for the large majority of total revenue at ¥6,380 million. By product category, tomato, cucumber, eggplant and watermelon seedlings are the largest, in that order; by delivery region, the order is Kanto, Kyushu/Okinawa, Hokkaido/Tohoku and Shikoku. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of the total, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. It is said to be an environment in which, while the number of agricultural management entities and core farmers declines, organizational management entities and larger-scale farming are advancing, and a shift to purchased seedlings is progressing.

entries.a821f89f33b69721: Among vegetable grafted seedlings, it specializes in root-cutting grafted seedlings, in which the roots are cut off before grafting, and for root-cutting grafting of Solanaceae vegetables it has established its own cultivation method based on long-standing cultivation technology. Closed-type seedling facilities, which artificially control light, temperature and other conditions, suppress the entry of pests and diseases, reduce pesticide use, and allow stable-quality seedlings to be produced throughout the year. Its features also include a production method in which grafting work is consolidated at its head office farm while secondary seedling-raising bases are expanded nationwide, and integrated management from order receipt to shipment using its in-house production and sales management system. It also offers original products, such as Earth Straight seedlings, whose root balls are wrapped in nonwoven fabric and can be planted as they are.

entries.ed71f2cba275376f: The medium-term management plan toward 2033, formulated in the fiscal year ended October 2024, aims to expand the business on the basis of its seedling business through agricultural materials and new products and technologies, and states that it will pursue a shift from quantity to quality, from revenue to profit, and from agriculture to manufacturing. It sets out four strategies: 'further expansion of the seedling business and strengthening of earnings capacity,' 'expansion of business areas starting from the seedling business,' 'development of new products and new technologies,' and 'strengthening of business infrastructure.' It positions the development of new plant vaccines and original varieties as key to expanding the business base, and states that it will take on the challenge of building a food value chain deepened from the seedling business into adjacent areas. Its basic management policy, with vegetable seedling production as its core business, is expressed as 'good seedlings anytime, anywhere, in any quantity.'
